# Country knowledge records

This folder contains all 27 EU country records plus Norway, which is already covered by the public page. A record does not require a public entry. All initial records are not_yet_researched under this new workflow; existing contributor content remains linked and unchanged. No external source was opened or claim independently verified in this setup.

Public-entry references point through [the current map](../public-map.json) to exact locations in the existing repository. The shared Commission entry is referenced by Croatia and Germany without duplicating it as a business-enforcement case. Missing public entries do not mean no enforcement exists.

The setup's existing backlog is retained as follow-up questions. These questions are not findings that existing claims are false. Follow the [record format](../record-format.md), [workflow](../workflow.md) and [presentation rules](../presentation.md) on a separately authorised content pass. Research attempts, verified claims and editorial maintenance have separate dates.
